data.name: Al Buen Callar Llaman Sancho
data.detailed_description:
Al Buen Callar Llaman Sancho is a third-person action-adventure game inspired by Don Quixote de la Mancha and the figure of Miguel de Cervantes. The player takes on the role of Sancho Panza in an idealized and fantastical reinterpretation of Cervantes' work, exploring Vesania, a world born from Don Quixote’s imagination where giants, wizards, and knights have come to life. Through combat, exploration, and mechanics that allow players to switch between the real world and the world of fantasy, Sancho must gather the fragments of the original Quixote manuscript in order to rescue the spirit of his master and confront Frestón, a malevolent sorcerer who threatens to rewrite history.

• Third-person action-adventure experience

• Inspired by Don Quixote and Cervantes’ literary universe

• Real-time melee combat with multiple stances and stamina management

• Sofros/Insania system enabling risk-reward combat transformations

• Dual-layer world: reality and fantasy interaction

• Stylized visuals with hand-crafted art direction
